agent-note:v1 — picked up (queue task 2342, Lane A, triage)

Triaging F12.9 against current main: checking whether versioned snapshots, a `migrate` export, probe-instance upgrade, or rollback machinery exists today in `pkgs/id`, and what checkpoint/snapshot pieces it would build on. Verdict + routing to follow in this pass.

agent-note:v1 — triage verdict: CONFIRMED ABSENT, routing deferred to prerequisites (queue task 2342, Lane A)

Verified on current main `b56ccda5` (laptop primary, HEAD == origin/main):

- **No upgrade path exists.** No `upgrade` entry point anywhere in `pkgs/id/src` (no `fn upgrade` / `upgrade_program`); nothing swaps a world's installed module for a new version.
- **Snapshots are unversioned.** `pkgs/id/src/world_store.rs` checkpoints hold guest-serialized state via the `plaza_snapshot` / `plaza_restore` exports with no format-version field, and `pkgs/id/src/sandbox.rs` (~:207, :234) validates exactly that export pair — there is no `migrate` export for a guest to transform old state.
- **The piece F12.9 reuses does exist:** world_store.rs (~:20) already verifies each checkpoint snapshot round-trips on a probe instance before trimming the journal — the probe-first pattern the upgrade is specified to follow.

Routing — deliberately NO implementation packet enqueued yet, same call as the #558 triage (task 2148):

- The Phase 12 plan's own dependency chain is F12.7 → F12.8 → F12.9 → F12.15, and both predecessors are still open: #1064 (F12.7 ABI specification — it defines the guest export surface a `migrate` export belongs to) and #1065 (F12.8 guest SDKs). Designing the migrate ABI inside F12.9 before F12.7 lands invites rework of exactly the surface F12.7 exists to pin.
- F12.9 is also effort/l design+implementation, not a small_fix; a claimable packet now would just park on its prerequisites.

Next action when #1064 closes (or its ABI draft pins the export surface): enqueue a staged implementation packet for this issue — (1) snapshot format version + `plaza_migrate`-style export in the sandbox validation, (2) probe-instance upgrade that commits only on migrated-state round-trip and otherwise leaves the old program running, (3) the plan's exit tests (counter across a format change; deliberately failing upgrade leaves the old program running). Downstream note: #558 already waits on this item, and F12.15 (`id world dev`) builds on it.

This triage task completes as `triaged`; the issue stays open with its `next` sequencing intact.

agent-note:v1
task: 7639
state: triaged

verdict: confirmed — not implemented on current main; fix path scoped; blocked on prerequisite ordering

Evidence (laptop primary ~/git/code at refs/remotes/origin/main d4d783461, 2026-11-03):
- No `migrate` export, no versioned program-state snapshot format, and no probe-instance upgrade path exists in pkgs/id: a tree-wide search of pkgs/id/src/world/, world_compile.rs, and world_store.rs finds no migrate/upgrade implementation for program state.
- The only upgrade/rollback machinery present is the journal contract (pkgs/id/src/world/mod.rs:960, from issue #227) plus JOURNAL_VERSION header bumping in world_store.rs — that versions the journal format, not a guest program's state across a program upgrade.
- The BUILDER capability (pkgs/id/src/world/mod.rs:154) already permission-gates "install and upgrade the world's program", so the authorization seam F12.9 needs exists; the migration mechanism itself does not.
- The spec source is intact: .opencode/plans/phase-12-platform-flexibility.md:45 states the F12.9 design and exit test verbatim (counter upgraded across a snapshot format change; a deliberately failing upgrade leaves the old program running).

Scoped fix path (when unblocked): versioned snapshot format for world program state + optional `migrate` export in the guest ABI + upgrade runner that migrates on a probe/checkpoint instance, commits only on a successful round-trip, and rolls back otherwise; exit tests per the plan.

Blockers / ordering (why no fix packet is enqueued yet): the plan's dependency chain is F12.7 -> F12.8 -> F12.9 -> F12.15 (phase-12 plan line 75). F12.9's versioned snapshots build on the versioned ABI specification (plaza_abi_version) from F12.7 — issue #1064, still OPEN — and F12.8 is issue #1065, also OPEN. The ordered prerequisite queue is tracked on issue #1235. Enqueueing an implementation packet now would only park against #1064; the correct next action is landing F12.7 (#1064), after which this issue is ready to scope as a small_fix packet. Downstream dependent: F12.15 `id world dev` (issue #558) consumes this migration path.

Partial verification — staying open (2026-11-07 done-task-only audit, tracking: https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/7016).

Queue task(s) [7639, 2342] were marked done, and some work did land:
- PR #1079 — docs(id): roadmap — Phase 12 + path to Phase 12 first (merged 2026-10-27T03:20:27Z): https://github.com/developing-today/code/pull/1079
- PR #4672 — docs: capture Phase 12 (#534) research package intake (merged 2026-11-03T14:25:22Z): https://github.com/developing-today/code/pull/4672

No merged change closes this issue's full scope, so the done status is not treated as completion. Remainder re-queued as triage task 11529.
